fact: The Ministry of Water and Environment page says the National Meteorological Centre has a Synergie system receiving satellite imagery in twelve infra-red and visible channels, plus an MDD system receiving satellite data and NWP products.

The Daily Monitor reports that the Ministry of Water and Environment's flood detection application, using Meteosat Third Generation rainfall estimates and satellite nowcasting with numerical weather models, is being piloted in Kampala and will later be scaled to other cities.
